description: Land Title Settlement Department - Vitanamulla, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510404
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
